identity.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][records] Normalize terminal SRP status during reconciliation

values.summary: Add bounded SRP normalization inside typed terminal reconciliation, prove projection and receipt parity, then regenerate #5452 terminal truth.

steps.action: Confirm current terminal reconciliation and SRP validation invariants
Normalize completed terminal SRP status inside the existing transaction
Add focused regression and regenerate #5452 projection

invariants: Only evidence-backed terminal SRP status is normalized
Receipt and projected record remain identical authorities
No AWS or remote execution is used
risks: Over-broad normalization could hide incomplete review truth
Projection and retained receipt could diverge if normalization occurs outside the atomic transaction
stop_conditions: The repair requires arbitrary terminal card mutation
Focused lifecycle proof cannot preserve receipt rollback guarantees
